grips.frame: inverse frozen wheel-rim partToVessel applied once to vessel-metre points
grips.endpointRule: Closed endpoints; abs(wrappedDifference)<=halfWidthRad+endpointRoundoffRad. The last term is numerical roundoff only, not a fit/compression allowance.
grips.handMeaning: Anatomical left/right for a seated avatar facing +X, not a camera/view label.
grips.tubeAzimuth: Entire tube circumference within the eligible major-circle arc; no other torus or spoke contact is implied.
grips.gapDefinition: hypot(x,hypot(y,z)-majorRadiusM)-tubeRadiusM, measured from the exact analytic torus surface, not its rendered chords
grips.gapRoundoffRule: Use ordinary numericToleranceM only to report a numerical comparison boundary; do not increase the normal interval or export a shifted target. Reference evaluator uses the closed interval exactly.
grips.singularityRule: Non-finite/sparse points, radial-axis points or centerline points with non-unique nearest normal reject; they do not select an arbitrary arc or normal.
grips.elementRule: All points/edges/faces of the proposed contacting palm/finger element must satisfy the same assigned arc and scoped gap. One passing point is insufficient.

supportRoles.seat: REQUIRED in any later seated reference evaluation
supportRoles.leftFoot: REQUIRED together with seat and rightFoot
supportRoles.rightFoot: REQUIRED together with seat and leftFoot
supportRoles.back: OPTIONAL permitted-contact region; no back contact is required to be seated. Absence of contact is not a failure; any actual back/garment contact must obey the existing finite patch and -2..+10mm interval, max2mm compression. Elsewhere the back remains an ordinary obstacle.
supportRoles.helm: Both assigned grips must be evaluated for a later two-hand frozen reference. Live released/reaching/throttle states and full-range choreography require a separately ACKed HUMANS profile; none is implied here.

retainedInteriors.reason: The source ledger binds surviving faces but does not bind exact retained closed-component face sets. Prior topology counts do not identify those faces. No baseline topology audit is repeated in this closure.
retainedInteriors.precedence: This explicitly scopes the prior reviewed-closed-interiors intention: do not infer an interior set, and do not treat absent classification as a surface-only clearance pass. Resolve at a separately versioned owner boundary before positive full-body acceptance.

guard.construction: First transform all three original triangle vertices by frozen sourceToVessel into vessel metres. Recompute a unit normal from these transformed edges. Extrude both sides by exactly0.002m along that normal and close all side faces. Never offset a source-space normal by0.002 then scale it through the source matrix.
guard.evaluation: Vessel-metre coordinates. A rigid vesselToWorld may be applied after construction; non-unit world scaling requires redefinition, not scaled guards.
guard.degenerateRule: Zero or numerically degenerate transformed triangles return unavailable, not silently skipped. Reference cross-product norm threshold1e-15m^2; non-affine/singular transforms reject.
guard.separationBoundary: Outside the union of closed triangle guards and new analytic/conservative solids, measured from the external guard/solid boundary, including guard side faces. It is NOT measured from the original triangle midplane or rendered bevel/chord. For an isolated planar face, normal distance from original plane must be at least0.004m (2mm guard+2mm ordinary separation). Unknown retained interiors prevent a positive whole-domain result.
guard.contactPrecedence: Only the named finite NEW part contact regions override ordinary separation/penetration for their named body elements. Retained original guards receive no cushion/grip exemption. Other union members remain obstacles, including at intended mechanical joints.

frozen.frameKind: Immutable design label; not host serial/replay cursor
frozen.vesselToWorld: identity; synthetic design world, not geographic coordinates
frozen.sourcePose: All original survivors use the supplied source-ledger restToVessel. All new parts use unchanged design local translations and baked source geometry. Both foot hinges exactly0; both legacy bolster value and target0; wheel and throttle angles0; gearNeutral,power0,rudder0.
frozen.mutationRule: Any transform, input, articulation, policy or geometry change requires a new immutable export/world digest. This file cannot acquire live validity by inserting timestamps, UUIDs or an epoch.

acceptance.requiredNextACK: Exact closure source commit, contract/export/manifest fingerprints and retained original package+source/geometry/support pins; explicitly accept frozen scope and unknown-interior limitation or identify a precise blocker. Only the existing HUMANS owner may then receive an authorized later evaluation; no work is dispatched by this export.
